complexity.notes: Per-iteration cost is constant since the number halves each time. A faster variant, ||clearing the lowest set bit with n & (n - 1)||, iterates only once per set bit rather than once per bit position; Python's built-in int.bit_count() does this in one call.
complexity.summary: Repeatedly reads the lowest bit with n % 2 and shifts right via integer division, accumulating the count until n becomes 0. Runs one iteration per bit of the input's binary length.
